front.title: Normalized Representation of YANG Data for Equivalence Evaluation

abstract.t: This document defines a normalization procedure for YANG-modeled information. The procedure enables different serialized representations conveying equivalent information to produce the same normalized representation independently of the input encoding and applicable representation conventions. The normalized representation is intended to support comparison, hashing, integrity verification, provenance, and other procedures that require consistent representation of equivalent YANG-modeled information.
